manifest.name: sequence-step
manifest.description: One ordered step of a sequence (BO-F3-03): the days after the previous fire, the channel it sends on, and the approved template with personalization variables. Steps are append-only while the sequence is a draft; once the sequence is active a step is never edited, only skipped per enrollment, so a running person never sees a step change under them. (backlog:22bb154a72ea)

migrations.name: create_sequence_steps
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sequence_steps (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  sequence_source_key TEXT,
  space_id TEXT,
  step_order INTEGER,
  day_offset INTEGER,
  channel TEXT,
  template_name TEXT,
  template_language TEXT,
  template_vars TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequence_steps_sequence_source_key ON sequence_steps(sequence_source_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequence_steps_space_id ON sequence_steps(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequence_steps_step_order ON sequence_steps(step_order);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_sequence_steps
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."sequence_steps" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "sequence_source_key" TEXT,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "step_order" BIGINT,
  "day_offset" BIGINT,
  "channel" TEXT,
  "template_name" TEXT,
  "template_language" TEXT,
  "template_vars" TEXT,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "sequence_steps_sequence_source_key"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_steps"("sequence_source_key");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_steps_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_steps"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "sequence_steps_step_order"
  ON "accordo"."sequence_steps"("step_order");
